t2.thesis: The entry-to-exit window is only the overnight gap into a BMO print, so the result turns on whether the stock's depressed, high-IV pre-earnings drift reverses into a beat-and-raise reaction, and I see only a slight edge over a coin flip.
reasons: The stock is down 32% over 1 month and 52% below its 52w high, so expectations are reset and the stock is cheap at about 10.6x forward PE, which favors a relief gap.
Estimates rose about 5.6% over 90 days, and the company has beaten EPS on each of the last 4 prints, with guidance raised last quarter.
The last 4 prints had only a 25% win rate on the open-to-open measure despite beats, with 3 of 4 down, which suggests sell-the-news behavior.
Heavy deal and financing news (EPC acquisition, $3.3B bridge, spin-off) adds balance-sheet risk, and Investor Day on Nov 10 is a possible catalyst that may limit the reaction.
The implied move of 18% is large and symmetric, so it gives no directional signal.
t2.deciding_variable: Whether the Q3 guidance and the AI infrastructure (CPI) outlook, together with the margin trajectory, reassure investors enough to offset the recent selloff.

prior.from: BMO session base rate 0.548 (validation overall 0.542); hardware_networking cluster 0.586 is closest but only a candidate, so I stayed near the BMO rate

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. That earnings date (2026-10-28) is after today's date (2026-10-26) and past my knowledge cutoff, so I have no information on how FLEX's stock reacted.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved down about 2 points from 0.55 to 0.53, because of the weak history of reactions to beats and the balance-sheet and spin-off overhang, partly offset by the oversold setup and rising estimates.

theses.expected: Rise: the beat and a raised FY guide meet an oversold stock, and short covering plus relief lift the open.
theses.mechanism: The stock fell 32% in a month, expectations are reset, the valuation is low, and AI and CPI demand supports the numbers.
theses.wrong_if: Guidance is only in line, or CPI margins compress because of memory costs and acquisition dilution.

theses.expected: Fall: sell-the-news again despite the EPS beat.
theses.mechanism: The stock fell after beats in 3 of the last 4 prints; the market is focused on leverage from the EPC deal and spin-off complexity.
theses.wrong_if: Management gives clear spin-off economics and cash flow improves.

theses.expected: Flat or choppy: a large gap in either direction is possible given the 18% implied move.
theses.mechanism: The stock has high uncertainty on guidance and free cash flow, and the market may be mixed on the AI-linked segment.
theses.wrong_if: The print moves the stock more than 10% in either direction.

key_observations: Fiscal Q3 guidance for revenue and adjusted EPS versus the roughly $1.06 consensus for Q2
Full-year guidance, which was $4.42-4.74 adjusted EPS
Free cash flow and working capital, since Q1 FCF was only $41M
CPI segment growth and margins, and memory cost pass-through
Leverage and spin-off commentary ahead of the Nov 10 Investor Day
